description: Start in Search with the full keyboard open and A focused. Arrow-only motion for material inspection; numeric 0/1 only adds and removes a space to enter T9. Collect production timing separately without captures.

steps.name: 01-letters-neighbor-glow
steps.review: White focused key reflects into nearby idle keys. Labels stay crisp above the source, no broad bloom, no ghost key after movement. Inspect modest RGB separation at contrasting curved edges.

steps.name: 02-t9-neighbor-glow
steps.review: T9 has the same shared glass and neighboring focus reflection. Query is empty after 1 deletes the space; ABC remains bottom-left. Compare active-motion p50/p95/p99 separately; a settled capture cannot prove performance.
